from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import json, sys, unittest
from tests.models import test_grc_v4_geometry as geometry, test_grc_v4_step as step, test_grc_v4_transport
root = Path.cwd()
record = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
prior = json.loads((Path(sys.argv[1]).parent / record['source']['prior_inputs']['path']).read_text())
hashes = prior['source_sha256'] | record['source']['source_overrides']
assert all(sha256((root / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == h for p, h in hashes.items())
classes = ('tests.models.test_grc_v4_geometry.CaptureIntegrityTests', 'tests.models.test_grc_v4_step.PrestatePreservationTests')
required = {name for name in step.p935_required(root) if any(name.startswith(c + '.') for c in classes)}
assert len(required) == 20
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(classes)
ids = geometry._p934_ids(suite)
assert geometry._p934_coverage(required, ids)['passed']
before = geometry._p934_loaded_sources(root, hashes)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=sys.stderr, verbosity=2, resultclass=geometry._P934Result).run(suite)
coverage = geometry._p934_coverage(required, ids, result.rows)
after = geometry._p934_loaded_sources(root, hashes)
assert all(after.get(name) == value for name, value in before.items())
assert all(sha256((root / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == h for p, h in hashes.items())
actual = dict(tests_run=result.testsRun, failures=len(result.failures), errors=len(result.errors), skips=len(result.skipped), coverage=coverage, methods=result.rows, source_unchanged=True, live_modules_before=len(before), live_modules_after=len(after), existing_live_modules_unchanged=True)
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(actual, indent=2) + '\n')
if not (result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped and coverage['passed'] and result.testsRun == 20):
    raise SystemExit(1)
print('P935_AUDIT_FOLLOWUP_PASS methods=20 failures=0 errors=0 skips=0')
